notes.title: 【Dev Log #3】The World’s Biggest Social Platform: Y
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/1ab7c523950bb9f82d7d185a072a09b7d797fe2d.png[/img]

Hey everyone!
This is Officer Zelda from the 4th Division of Criminal Investigation!
Today’s mission is to introduce you to the game’s online investigation feature.
No time to waste—let’s dive in!

[h2]🔍 One of the top platforms VTubers love: Y.[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/64b020777c1c21611f7b8fc2793ae089fef5f6a0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/64b020777c1c21611f7b8fc2793ae089fef5f6a0.gif[/img][/url]
As a professional detective, online digging is a must.
So… what do I always check?
[h3]🖼️ Images posted on the platform are super important—especially screenshots of chat logs.[/h3]
[h3]🏷️ Popular tags can lead you to a whole trail of related posts.[/h3]
[h3]👤 Click on suspicious users and snoop through their profiles for clues.[/h3]
[h3]💬 Replies with tons of comments? Might be hiding something juicy.[/h3]

⚠️ Just a heads-up—rumors are everywhere online.
If it hasn’t been verified by yours truly, don’t expect it to stand up in court!
Consider that your legal pro-tip of the day.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/d9339648b93730cd5c33072d4e18db86f77efa22.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/88d2fdce06b0ee3c15f3cac8786b8e735816b9fa.png[/img][/url]
💡 And yep, sometimes I’ll even slide into those DMs for a little undercover chit-chat.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/1fe35c45eb5381912c9a43db4eca950d65f2e709.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/1fe35c45eb5381912c9a43db4eca950d65f2e709.gif[/img][/url]
Sure, internet folks can be a bit clueless, but they sometimes drop gold.
So online info? Super useful.
And for the record—I'm not chatting just to follow cute girls’ accounts. No way. Definitely not. Probably.

[h2]📘 Coming Up Next: The Courtroom Rules Explained[/h2]
Word is, the next guide will be delivered by a super cute defense attorney!
I am, uh, professionally excited.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/afeece0eced5e4e22e483031d77d0d41684d1fbf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/e483814ffbc9bc1d024f025f79862f69755d9428.png[/img][/url]
[h2]🕹️ Launching in Q4 2025[/h2]
If you’re curious about what virtual girls are hiding online...
Add us to your wishlist now 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

notes.title: 【Devlog #2】Logic Aligned. Trial Begins.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/2ef1c3e3fc07863216ee060957de1490953e96c1.png[/img]
What? Me? Writing a devlog?
I’m busy, you know!? Are you kidding me!?
Ugh... Sushi... Fine! Fiiine, I’ll do it!
So I just read it out loud, right?...Okay, here goes.

"Hi everyone, this is the team behind The Real Face of a VTuber.

Recently, we’ve implemented the full scenario into the game engine, and started testing logic and event triggers.
To be honest, this is one of the most complex and mind-bending phases of development so far.
Because our mystery paths? Never straight lines.

⚠️ Be careful—evidence that proves suspect A guilty… might just be a trap when it comes to suspect B."

[h2]⚖️ A sneak peek at the courtroom system:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/7d9e004166d0fd9dd050ef32968fd206ebc67768.gif[/img]
"🤝 Friendly Witness Phase: Follow courtroom procedures and guide them to say something helpful.
🔍 Hostile Witness Phase: Spot the contradictions, and strike back.
🗯 Objection Phase: If the other side’s questioning crosses the line, raise your voice—Objection!

Not familiar with courtroom rules? Don’t worry.
You’ll have a cute and capable assistant right by your side."
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/90bd7c42c13d5625a732bb5a6676c96394b8dea3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/f523eb2206584d0a98686ba8407da3d0d1e2f19c.png[/img][/url]
...Wait, am I the “cute and capable assistant” here!?

[h2]🌐 Next up: Social Media Investigation[/h2]
"We’re working on a key feature—the in-game platform “Y” that many VTubers use.
You’ll read fan comments, hate messages, and suspicious posts…
But can you trust what you see?
How will you know who’s lying and who’s just loud?"


[h2]🕵️‍♂️ Scheduled for release in Q4 2025[/h2]
"We’re unlocking more and more of the game’s core features—
If you’re ready to face the suspects head-on,
be sure to add us to your wishlist! 👇"
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/ddeecafcf4d3617e5db69f0fc806ef883d8323e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/93603eb768e2bfd2ef4c59d0138518258c3f061f.png[/img][/url]
All done, right? Don’t forget about that sushi you promised me!

notes.title: 【Devlog #1】The lies are in place. The truth is coming soon.
notes.content:
Hey there, we’re the team behind The Real Face of a VTuber.

We’ve just wrapped up the core of the project: the full game script.
Now, we’re moving into translation—and trust us, every ending comes with twists and revelations.
Ready to challenge the suspects?

Just one piece of advice: Don’t trust what the characters say too easily.
If you think you're in control, you might already be caught in the trap.

[h2]🎮 Sneak Peek at Gameplay[/h2]
We’ve begun testing gameplay features, and here’s a glimpse of one of our latest scenes👇
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/739a76b8ae421081ee2eec8005523ddaae63b58b.gif[/img]

What looks like a harmless livestream chat... is anything but:

🧩 Comment timing is carefully synced with the VTuber's lines for natural flow

🎨 Members vs non-members are color-coded for instant recognition

💬 Super Chat system lets you ask questions—but also raises the stakes

After all, when you question a VTuber live…
A Super Chat is the bare minimum courtesy.

[h2]⚖️ Next Stage: Courtroom Battle[/h2]
We’re diving into one of the biggest features: Courtroom debates.
Here’s what’s coming up next:

A defense attorney who wasn’t in the demo

A new “Objection Phase” to challenge the defense’s legitimacy

Dynamic viewpoint switching during courtroom arguments

A new debate is about to begin. Are you ready?

[h2]🕵️‍♂️ Releasing in Q4 2025[/h2]
If you enjoy layered mysteries and psychological twists—
Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/

notes.title: Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings to all prosecutors.

The adjustments in this version update are as follows:

1. Changed the questioning phase to a mission search system. Now, you can progress in reasoning as soon as you ask about a key clue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/182d535718a637c49625258f4259e21d207669c0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/454aff04c98070477d88cd5154973bbb3870d5e8.png[/img]

2. Optimized the display of character names and pictures in the notebook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/3c68fdd7519516c4222c288de85710a27f0486e7.png[/img]

3. Added a game tutorial, so you'll no longer miss any important features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957213/bb552a118d8ebd40efa2fb47596579c941b3700a.png[/img]

4. Added guidance hints for incorrect choices.

5. Optimized the multilingual localization scripts.

We wish you a pleasant case-solving experience!

Lilien Games

notes.title: Planned Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Prosecutors,

Thank you for playing our game and for your valuable feedback. We would like to inform you about the planned updates:

1. We are adding a tutorial window to address the following issues:
  ‧ Lack of guidance on how to open and use the notebook.
  ‧ Insufficient guidance during the evidence presentation phase.

2. We will introduce hints and guidance for the reasoning phase to improve the trial-and-error process.

3. Adjustments to the questioning conditions for the six suspects and the addition of system prompts to improve the excessively lengthy early game stages.

Our team is currently very busy and cannot update immediately, but we are committed to providing a better investigative environment.

Wishing you a pleasant investigation!

Lilien Games

notes.title: Taipei Game Show Version Released! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is Now Free to Play
notes.content:
[h2]The highly acclaimed, intriguingly artistic courtroom game! "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is now available for free on Steam.[/h2]

https://youtu.be/qnV1jmTOOLw

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is a mystery game for PC, serving as a special exhibition edition of the developing game "The Real Face of a VTuber". Players take on the role of a prosecutor, accusing a malicious developer who showcased a game with deliberately rough art at a game exhibition. This has now been adapted into a special Steam version and released as a free game for interested players to experience.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/76769eb81da715bf610e369cb3b69fbea8865722.png[/img]

Players will prosecute the malicious developer for "deceiving players with deliberately rough art," with the accused being none other than the development team, "Lilien Games". The game features amusing and "artistic" visuals, including a defense attorney unhappy with their appearance, a relieved prosecutor who wasn't targeted, and a witness bullied for having a complete sprite. The indictment's premise is sure to bring a smile to players' faces.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/9f55b26888c3cebc9eccba7dfa3ba1c5d44792b9.png[/img]

As a special exhibition edition, the game itself boasts a high level of completeness. Players can name the protagonist, experience two courtroom phases ("Prosecution Witness Interrogation" and "Defense Witness Interrogation"), and achieve four different outcomes based on their actions, even earning a certificate of qualification. Despite its promotional nature, the game still offers an enjoyable experience.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/86c7a322d09e509323eb5a775ad8996eab803456.png[/img]

This is a game designed to promote our main game. The new game "The Real Face of a VTuber" is a VTuber-themed mystery and puzzle game. However, due to the deadline for the game exhibition registration, the core VTuber artwork was not yet complete, leading to the creation of this special edition. Now, "The Real Face of a VTuber" has its Steam store page up and is scheduled for release in Q4 2024. We invite interested players to download "Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" and get an early taste of the whimsical story style and courtroom debate gameplay.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44915859/0533bde9849b5fc61c36ea69d98283e76e4c9b4a.png[/img]

"Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough" is available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese, and is free to play on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988880/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140/
